fr_html: Sur la proposition du PRESIDENT il est décidé que la rédaction finale de l'alinéa sera laissée à M. de Lapradelle qui la présentera demain.
en_html: On the PRESIDENT's suggestion, it was decided that the final wording of the paragraph should be left to M. de Lapradelle, who would submit it on the following day.
